## History

John Andrew was a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) during the time the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) undertook their project to paint the local hall. Although the society members intended for the building to be painted green, a mix-up with the paint numbers caused it to be painted bright blue instead.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +25 more_
